name: smoke-suites-registered-in-no-inventory
title: A test suite can fall out of every inventory and fail indefinitely with no signal
description: evidence-plan-smoke and candidate-spec-routing-smoke both fail against the main checkout's own build, and both are absent from test:serial-reference, the full-suite runner's RESOURCE_POLICY and the config's validate commands. npm test builds its entry list from the serial reference, so a suite named in none of the three is executed by no gate and can stay red forever. The defect is the missing signal rather than the two failures: nothing reports that a suite file is reachable from no inventory. Note that a naive name-matching sweep over the tasks directory misclassifies in both directions and must not be trusted or quoted.
